connectionError.need: keep your houses, paint colors and designs
connectionError.devHint: Development: `npm run dev` starts it, or run it yourself with `npm run server`, then retry.
connectionError.portTaken: Another program is using port {port}. Close it, then press {retry}.

notFound.title: There's no page here
notFound.message: The address doesn't match any page of the app.

settings.title: Settings

photos.title: Photos
photos.hint: The copies made when a photo is added: the one the screen paints on, the card in Your houses, how big a photo may be, and the most pixels Save image and the AI photo work at — a bigger photo is scaled down to it.

designs.title: Designs and paint files
designs.hint: How many designs a house keeps, and how big a palette file may be.

finder.title: Part finder
finder.hint: Whether the graphics card helps find the parts, when the finder lets go of its memory, and how far past the house a part may reach — so a car parked in front isn't taken for a door.

windows.title: Other windows
windows.hint: The app open in more than one place at once — the desktop app, a browser on this server, a phone: how often each one looks for what the others changed. It shows their changes by itself.

aiphoto.title: AI photo
aiphoto.hint: The size the AI draws at, in pixels: bigger is sharper and slower. Other programs holding the graphics card make it slower too: above the amount below, the AI photo names them (0 never does).

photos.fullSizeMaxMegapixels: Save image and the AI photo, at most (megapixels)

finder.houseMargin: Parts reach past the house by (share of the photo)
finder.houseMinShare: A piece counts when this share of it is on the house

windows.checkSeconds: Look for other windows' changes every (seconds)

aiphoto.sharedGpuNoteMb: Name other programs holding more of the graphics card than (MB)

settings.appearanceHint: How the app looks — applied at once and kept by the app.
settings.backupsHint: A backup holds everything the app keeps: your houses with their photos and designs, the paint colors, your settings and your AI setup. The downloaded engines and models aren't in it — they download again.
settings.logsHint: What the server and this window reported, newest last.

remove.partFinderMessage: This frees {size}. Your houses keep the parts already found; finding parts again needs the part finder installed again.
remove.aiPhotoMessage: This frees {size}. Your AI photos stay; making a new one needs the AI photo installed again.

about.blurb: See your house in real paint colors before you buy paint: its parts found on your computer, real brand paints in the photo's own light, color schemes, designs and an AI photo.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.hint: The structured settings, as JSON. Each is checked by the app's server when you save it.

finder.parts: What the part finder looks for
finder.priority: Which part keeps a pixel two parts claim

schemes.roleParts: Which parts each scheme color paints

aiphoto.compose: How the AI photo is put back on the photo

paints.colorOrder: How colors are ordered by color

finder.parts: Each part: its key, its words to the finder, its threshold, and whether it is painted.

schemes.roleParts: For body, trim and accent: the part keys each paints.
schemes.harmony: The thresholds the schemes are built and checked with.

aiphoto.templates: The words the AI photo model reads.
aiphoto.compose: The blend and the color lock after the AI draws.

paints.colorOrder: grayChroma: below this CIE chroma a color is a near-gray (listed first, light to dark); bandDegrees: the hue bands the rest are listed in; families: the Color family filter, each from its hue (degrees) to the next one’s.

empty.title: No houses yet
empty.message: Add a photo of your house — taken from the front, in daylight, with the whole house in view.

delete.title: Delete this house?
delete.message: “{name}”, its photo, its parts, its designs and its AI photos will be deleted. This can't be undone.

gone.title: This house isn't here any more
gone.message: It was deleted. Your other houses are on Your houses.

find.againMessage: The parts found now replace the ones this house has.
find.keep: Keep the parts you changed by hand: {parts}
find.emptyMessage: The part finder outlines the body, the trim, the doors and the rest, so each can be painted on its own.
find.noneTitle: No parts found on this photo
find.noneMessage: The finder didn't recognize a house here. A photo with the house in full view, from the front, works best — or try again.

ai.needOutline: No part to paint has an outline yet — draw one with the brush or a box
ai.needColors: Give a part a color first

tools.label: Tool
tools.lookHint: Click a part to select it; drag to move the photo; the wheel zooms
tools.brushHint: Paint more of the photo into the selected part
tools.eraserHint: Take some of the photo out of the selected part
tools.boxHint: Draw a box around something the selected part should take in
tools.offWhileFinding: Off while the parts are being found — their new outlines replace these when it's done
tools.pickHint: Click the photo to read its color there and find the brand's nearest paints
tools.lightHint: A brighter or duller day over the whole picture — 1 is the photo's own light

house.undoOffWhileFinding: Off while the parts are being found — the history starts over from the parts it finds

zoom.fitHint: Fit the photo to the view

canvas.label: The photo of the house
canvas.keys: When it is zoomed in, the arrow keys move it. The brush, the eraser and the box need a mouse, a pen or touch.

leave.message: The colors on screen have changes that aren't saved in a design. Leaving the house drops them.

partsTab.hint: Select a part to paint it, or to fix its outline with the brush, the eraser or a box.
partsTab.deltaEHint: How far the paint on the screen is from the paint chip (ΔE2000). Under 2 is hard to tell apart.
partsTab.deltaEClose: — a close match to the paint chip: under 2 is hard to tell apart
partsTab.deltaEFar: — not a close match to the paint chip: under 2 is hard to tell apart
partsTab.photographed: As photographed: {hex} — find the nearest paints

colors.none: No paint colors on this computer yet. Add a brand's colors first.
colors.loadingBrands: The brands' colors are loading — a few seconds, this first time.
colors.pickPart: Select a part (Parts tab, or click it on the photo) to paint it.

exact.title: An exact color
exact.hint: A color you saw somewhere else: the brand's closest paints, closest first.
exact.deltaEHint: How far the paint is from this color (ΔE2000). Under 2 is hard to tell apart.
exact.deltaEClose: — a close match to this color: under 2 is hard to tell apart
exact.deltaEFar: — not a close match to this color: under 2 is hard to tell apart
exact.picked: From the photo — its light and shadow are in this color, so the nearest paint is close, not exact.

colors.moreBrands: {n} more brand on Paint colors | {n} more brands on Paint colors

target.label: What a paint you pick sets

now.label: On it now:
now.hint: Pick the paint this part has today, if you know it: the app works out the photo's real light from it, so every new paint shows as your camera would have seen it. Not sure? The color as photographed (the dot on the Parts tab) finds the closest paints.

schemes.hint: Body, trim and front door colors that go together — all real paints. Apply paints this house's parts.

harmony.title: From a paint you chose
harmony.needBase: Give the body a color first (Colors tab) — the schemes are built around it.
harmony.otherBrand: The body's paint is {brand}'s — choose {brand} above, or give the body a color of this brand.

why.noHue: The paint is nearly gray: it has no hue to build this scheme on. Classic works with any color.
why.noBody: No paint of this brand to use for the body.
why.noTrim: No paint of this brand near the trim's color is light or dark enough against the body.
why.noAccent: No paint of this brand near the door's color is colorful enough and far enough from the body.
why.pairTrim: The trim the brand pairs with it isn't light or dark enough against the body.
why.pairNoAccent: The brand pairs no further color with it for the door.
why.pairAccent: The door color the brand pairs with it isn't colorful enough, or is too close to the body.
why.other: This scheme can't be made from this brand's paints.

ai.title: Ask the AI
ai.hint: The AI looks at what stays — the roof, the stone, the windows — and suggests schemes that suit it.
ai.moodPlaceholder: warm and welcoming, a coastal look…
ai.needParts: Find the parts first: the AI reads the house's colors from them.

designs.hint: Save the colors on screen as a design to compare later. The colors stay a draft until you save them.
designs.name: Name

discard.title: Leave the colors on screen?
discard.message: The colors on screen have changes that aren't saved in a design. Opening another design replaces them.

delete.title: Delete this design?
delete.message: The design “{name}” will be deleted. Its AI photos stay.

trimOffer.message: {parts} has no color in this design. | {parts} have no color in this design.
trimOffer.paint: Paint it the trim's color | Paint them the trim's color

renders.title: AI photos
renders.none: No AI photos yet — the AI photo button makes one from the colors on screen.
renders.deleteMessage: The AI photo will be deleted. This can't be undone.

designs.colorCardHint: The painted photo and its paints in one picture, to take to the store

aiPhoto.title: AI photo
aiPhoto.note: A picture the AI drew with your colors: the light and shadows look real, but small details can change. The instant preview stays the accurate one.
aiPhoto.sharedGpu: Other programs on the computer that draws it held {size} of its graphics card when it started ({programs}), which makes the AI photo slower. Close them for the fastest one.

finder.title: Install the part finder
finder.body: The part finder outlines the body, the trim, the doors and the rest of the house on your photo. It runs on this computer: a one-time download of {size}.
finder.bodyNoSize: The part finder outlines the body, the trim, the doors and the rest of the house on your photo. It runs on this computer.
finder.cantRun: The part finder can't run on this computer: its engine didn't load ({error}). Nothing was downloaded.

aiphoto.title: Install the AI photo
aiphoto.body: The AI photo redraws your photo with the colors you chose, with real light and shadow. It runs on this computer: a one-time download of {size}.
aiphoto.bodyNoSize: The AI photo redraws your photo with the colors you chose, with real light and shadow. It runs on this computer.
aiphoto.slow: This computer has no graphics card the AI photo can use: one AI photo would take about ten minutes.
aiphoto.unavailable: The AI photo's engine has no build for this computer's system and processor, so it can't be installed here.

paintColors.title: Paint colors
paintColors.lede: The brands' real paint colors, kept on this computer. Each brand's colors load by themselves the first time the app starts — from the brand's public list or the palette files on its website; turn Load automatically off for a brand you don't want.

remove.title: Remove the {brand} colors?
remove.message: The {n} {brand} colors will be removed from this computer. Designs that use them show no color until they are added again.
remove.messageUsed: The {n} {brand} colors will be removed from this computer. {designs} use them — those parts show no color until the colors are added again.

lost.title: Designs lost a color
lost.message: {designs} use colors that {brand} no longer has. Those parts show no color until you pick new ones.

paintColors.note: Colors on a screen are close to the paint, never the same: check a real paint chip before you buy. Brand names belong to their owners; this app isn't connected to any of them.

jobs.failed: The work stopped with an error.

colorCard.note: Colors on a screen are close to the paint, never the same — check a real paint chip before you buy.
